note:
身份: 寻宝猎人
关系: 收费提供宝藏线索
说话方式: 精明、有点市侩
性格与词汇: 情报费、挖宝
禁用风格: 只转述线索,不额外报坐标答案
Wiki 最后编辑: This page was last edited on 11 August 2026, at 23:37.

entries.context: First Interaction
entries.raw: §fI'm the Treasure Hunter, I've been searching for treasure all over this island.
entries.text: I'm the Treasure Hunter, I've been searching for treasure all over this island.
entries.zh: 我是寻宝猎人,这座岛上到处都留下过我寻宝的足迹。

entries.context: First Interaction
entries.raw: §fRumor has it that there are rare stones and other valuable bounty hidden in the ground all over the island.
entries.text: Rumor has it that there are rare stones and other valuable bounty hidden in the ground all over the island.
entries.zh: 听说岛上各处的地下,都埋着稀有的石头和其他值钱的宝贝。

entries.context: First Interaction
entries.raw: §fTell you what, for a small price I'll give you the info I know about.
entries.text: Tell you what, for a small price I'll give you the info I know about.
entries.zh: 这样吧,给我一点报酬,我就把知道的消息告诉你。

entries.context: Selecting [YES] Without Enough Coins
entries.text: Are you trying to scam me?
entries.zh: 你想空手套情报啊?

entries.context: Selecting [YES] Without Enough Coins
entries.text: You don't have enough money.
entries.zh: 你的钱不够。

entries.context: Selecting [YES] Without Enough Coins
entries.raw: §fCome back when you have enough for the tip.
entries.text: Come back when you have enough for the tip.
entries.zh: 凑够情报费再来吧。

entries.context: After Receiving Tip
entries.text: Did you forget the tip?
entries.zh: 忘了我给的线索?

entries.context: After Receiving Tip
entries.raw: §fJust for you I'll tell you it again at no charge!
entries.text: Just for you I'll tell you it again at no charge!
entries.zh: 这回算你走运,我免费再说一遍!

entries.context: After Receiving Tip
entries.raw: §fRemember, you need to DIG to find the treasure!
entries.text: Remember, you need to DIG to find the treasure!
entries.zh: 记住,想找到宝藏,得动手挖!

entries.context: On Cooldown
entries.raw: §fSorry I dont have any more info.
entries.text: Sorry I dont have any more info.
entries.zh: 抱歉,我没别的消息了。

entries.context: On Cooldown
entries.raw: §fCome back in §93§f SkyBlock days and I might know something new.
entries.text: Come back in 3 SkyBlock days and I might know something new.
entries.zh: 过 3 个 SkyBlock 日再来,也许到时就有新消息了。

segments.text: SkyBlock days and I might know something new.
segments.zh: 个 SkyBlock 日再来,也许到时就有新消息了。

entries.context: After Cooldown
entries.text: Glad to see you again adventurer!
entries.zh: 又见面了,冒险者!

entries.context: After Cooldown
entries.raw: §fYou know the drill, for a small fee I will give you some info on the treasure.
entries.text: You know the drill, for a small fee I will give you some info on the treasure.
entries.zh: 规矩你懂的,给点小钱,我就告诉你一些宝藏的消息。

entries.context: 宝藏位置线索，不添加坐标或解谜答案
entries.text: In the Mushroom Gorge where blue meets the ceiling and floor, you will find what you are looking for.
entries.zh: 在蘑菇峡谷里,蓝色与洞顶、地面相接的地方,就有你要找的东西。
